ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review as a SAFE-1 matter and hold the fare dispute in the queue; + flag_account
ruling.escalation_reason: SAFE-1: a chat fact is tagged [threat] (F7) with threat keywords detected (F8), so no automated ruling is issued; a human reviewer must assess the safety item and then the route-deviation dispute (single 0.77 km off-route segment, F3; no traffic incident, F12; no recorded rider consent, F7/F9).

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 09:49–09:52 with +0.77 km (2.15 km vs 1.38 km optimal, up to 1019 m off route). No traffic incident near the route in the trip window, so RD-4(a) is not met [F12][RD-4]; the AYE/CTE band-4 records (30–39 km/h) are not band 1–2 and cannot exempt a segment on their own [F10][F11][RD-4]; no rider consent to a named reroute before the segment starts is recorded, only the 09:35 lobby message [F7], while the driver concedes the reroute [F9][RD-5]. Provisional finding, not a final ruling due to SAFE-1 escalation [SAFE-1].

rejected_claims.reason: Not decided on the merits: the case is escalated under SAFE-1 because of the [threat]-tagged chat fact [F7][F8][SAFE-1]. Factually, the off-route segment it relies on does exist [F3], but whether it is unexempt turns on RD-4/RD-5, which is left for the human reviewer.

Not decided on the merits (SAFE-1 escalation) [F8][SAFE-1]. Note for the reviewer: the arithmetic it concedes is correct — 0.77 km × $1.41/km = $1.09 [F3][F4], and the full $2.30 excess-distance line includes ~0.83 km of non-refundable residual [F1][F4][RD-2].

Rejected as a decided claim: SAFE-1 bars an automatic ruling [F8][SAFE-1]. On the strict rule, RD-4(a) fails because no traffic incident is recorded in the trip window [F12], and RD-4(b) band evidence does not exempt a segment alone, and band 4 (30–39 km/h) is not band 1–2 [F10][F11][RD-4].

Rejected as a decided claim: SAFE-1 bars an automatic ruling [F8][SAFE-1]. Silence in chat is not the prior, explicit agreement RD-5 requires; the only pre-segment message is the 09:35 pickup note [F7] and the driver's own statement concedes the reroute [F9][RD-5].
Conceded by both sides and left undisturbed: the driver profile shows 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F15], so RD-6's repeated-breach predicate is not met; no account action is taken [RD-6][F15].
